title: ws-voice-join (app to server)

scope.description: run: the joined participants of the run; session: the owner and the viewers of the Session.

mic.description: on: open microphone; off: muted by the person; ptt: push-to-talk (sends only while the key is held).

description: A member joins the voice room of a run or Session (rooms are in memory only, at most 8 devices). A device is in one room at a time: joining another room leaves the old one. mic is optional and defaults to ptt. Non-members get error forbidden, a full room gets conflict, bad fields get bad_request. The server answers with voice_room to every device in the room. Needs together_v1.
